Definition: of foreign origin; Cappadocia, a region of Asia Minor:--Cappadocia.
BiblicalUsage: Cappadocia is a region of Asia Minor, named among the dwellers at Pentecost and among the scattered strangers Peter writes to. The men of Cappadocia heard the wonderful works of God in their own tongue, and the exiles of the dispersion in Cappadocia received Peter's letter of hope.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Cappadocia shows the gospel travelling: heard at Pentecost in one tongue, written to exiles in another land, and the same hope reaching both.
